summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iter 216h115 features: tamper-evident audit trail, OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE classification scanner, and acceptance/closure loop. All 8 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend testing verified Classification Banner, All Sites Overview with Audit/Site Login buttons, and public confirm-fix page.

issues: The MOD-specific 6-step fault wizard with classification hint (mod-field-classification-hint) is defined in MODSiteDashboard but MOD users are routed to the standard Pulse dashboard (/pulse) which uses the standard fault form. The MOD Fault Wizard is not currently accessible via the main navigation flow.

action_items: Consider routing MOD site users to MODSiteDashboard or integrating the MOD Fault Wizard into the standard Pulse dashboard for MOD users to expose the classification hint feature
seed_data_creation: Called /api/mod/demo/seed-army-catterick to create Catterick Garrison hierarchy with 7 sub-sites
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter 216h115 features are working: (1) Classification scanner detects NSN patterns and flags issues, (2) Audit log with tamper-evident hash chain is functional with CSV export including integrity footer, (3) Acceptance loop works - mark-resolved sends token, public confirm-fix page allows Y/N + rating, rejection reopens issue, 48h timeout sweep reopens pending acceptances. Classification Banner appears for MOD users only. All Sites Overview shows Audit and Site Login buttons per row.

classification_scanner.details: scan_text correctly flags NSN patterns (1234-12-345-6789), Operation names, callsigns, and SECRET keywords. Fault submission with NSN returns classification_flags in response.

audit_trail.details: GET /api/mod/pro/audit-log/{site_id} returns rows with row_hash and prev_hash forming tamper-evident chain. integrity.valid=true when chain is intact. Legacy rows without hashes are tolerated.

csv_export.details: GET /api/mod/pro/audit-log/{site_id}/export.csv returns CSV with header, event rows, and footer line '# CHAIN INTEGRITY: VALID'

acceptance_loop_happy_path.details: POST mark-resolved returns acceptance_token_sent=true. Public confirm-fix page shows ticket info, Yes/No buttons, 1-5 star rating. Submitting Yes closes ticket and shows success state. Token is single-use (subsequent GET returns 404).

acceptance_loop_rejection.details: POST with confirmed=false reopens issue with status=open and reopened_reason=reporter_rejected_fix

48h_timeout_sweep.details: sweep_pending_acceptances() finds acceptance_status=pending rows older than 48h and reopens them with reason=awaiting_reporter_review

classification_banner.details: Banner with '◆OFFICIAL◆' appears for MOD users (mod_site, mod_branch, mod_org) but NOT for standard Pulse users

all_sites_overview.details: Shows 7 Audit buttons and 7 Site Login buttons for MOD child sites. Clicking Audit opens panel with integrity indicator and CSV export button.

public_confirm_fix_page.details: Invalid token shows error message. Valid token shows ticket info, Yes/No buttons, star rating, and submit button. Success state shows confirmation message.
